verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions dedicated IP provisioning or any warmup capability, whether automated ramp-up or a published schedule. The only IP-related item is blocklist monitoring of sending IPs, which is an adjacent deliverability feature and is not credited. Dedicated IPs are a fair axis for a transactional email service, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a deliverability manager, I can get dedicated IPs with documented warmup — automated ramp-up or a published warmup schedule — when my volume outgrows shared pools
